harm_gate_rule: Fallback when pre-solve graph structure and early adaptive telemetry show hub-first ordering on an even wheel, or unnecessary reordering of a complete graph with enough colors.
methodology_note: All policy labels and certificates come from complete exact search. The adaptive loop and harm gate only choose a variable order before the final exact solve.
